This location is always well-stocked with everything I need for my kitties, and the customer service has been excellent, especially in recent months with the addition of new faces as well as familiar ones!

They are open 30 min later than any other petco (any other pet store , rather )which is a plus and they have a wider selection than it's neighboring stores as well. They have also got the self service dog wash area which I believe is $20 , also the only one around.

We arrived there a few minutes before closing. Staff was friendly, helpful and patient. We picked out which fish on the tank we wanted and the employee was patient in capturing them to ensure I got the one I wanted.
This store is close enough that when I need kitty items. I always find what I need for my cats at Petco. When needed the staff is helpful and nice.

The team at this Petco location always does an incredible job with my Husky and Aussie! Matt is super knowledgeable, and trusting them with two massive, double-coated dogs really speaks for itself.
​Ignore the negative review below—wearing open-toed shoes on a city street is wild behavior anyway!

I am so disappointed in Petco grooming when I brought in Harvey I was very specific in what not to do. the person who groomed him just took a razor and cut all his hair. No trimming around the eyes or face and they just shaved everything off instead of actually grooming him. They did absolutely nothing no grooming at all to his tail either. The Manager Matthew is a horrible example of a manager he was the person I spoke to when I brought him in. Horrible horrible job done by this Petco much ado to the horrible Manager Matthew he doesn’t even look the same to just be lazy and take a razor and shave all the hair around face and body what a shame
